column1: # capability group, build A (note 0009 D7.1, B04). Builder A, 2026-11-20.
# Sources: EasyMesh through the usp-spec MCP server (doc easymesh): §17.2.6 Table 28, §17.2.7 Table 29, §17.2.8 Table 30,
#   Byte order: EasyMesh §3.1.2 (multi-octet integers big-endian), except 0xAA MCS maps (note 0009 A3, little-endian).
#   TLV codes from the tables match em-types codes.rs:266-269 (0x85-0x88), 277-278 (0x90, 0x91), 294 (0xa1),
#   Upstream (pinned ba4180b, read from an extracted copy): em.cpp:1086-1135 (0x85 sender), :1137-1155 (0xa1),
#   :101-170 and :316-385 (add sites); em_configuration.cpp:3871-3911 (0xcb second sender; callers :1800-1806 and
#   :3626-3628 skip an empty value). em_base.h:1970-2003 (0xdf structs). upstream_tlv_vectors.tsv row
#   234-236 (0xd4), 273 (0xdd), 274-277 (0xdf). Note 0009 D2 (raw reserved values; zero counts), D3 lines 3/221/222,
#   D4 (0xcb empty value lenient; 0x85 holed form has no lenient form, B04 plan), D5 (0x91 frame body = 802.11 bytes),
#   D8 (zero where the spec says one or more is invalid), A3 (HE-MCS order).
#   0xa1: 1 octet: OnChMetrics b7, OffChMetrics b6, RCPISteer b5, M8_bSTA_Reconfiguration b4, b3-0 reserved (Table 28
#         prints "bits 4-0 Reserved"; bit 4 is M8, so read as bits 3-0). Exactly 1 octet (audit 39).
#   0x85: RUID(6), Max_BSS(1), Num_OpClass(1), Num_OpClass x { OpClass(1), Max_TxPower(1, signed 2's complement dBm),
#         Num_NonOpCh(1), Num_NonOpCh x NonOpCh(1) }, contiguous (audit 40). Num_OpClass, Num_NonOpCh may be 0 (audit 42).
#         Max_BSS "non-zero" sizes nothing: carried raw, 0 accepted (D2; upstream writes the BSS count, audit 44).
#   0x86: RUID(6), octet: Max_TxSS b7-6, Max_RxSS b5-4, ShortGI20 b3, ShortGI40 b2, HT40 b1, b0 reserved. Exactly 7.
#   0x87: RUID(6), VHT_TxMCS(2, BE), VHT_RxMCS(2, BE) (audit 48 SPEC), octet1: Max_TxSS b7-5, Max_RxSS b4-2, ShortGI80 b1,
#         ShortGI160 b0; octet2: VHT8080 b7, VHT160 b6, SUbeamformer b5, MUbeamformer b4, b3-0 reserved. Exactly 12.
#   0x88: RUID(6), k(1), k octets MCS, octet1: Max_TxSS b7-5, Max_RxSS b4-2, HE8080 b1, HE160 b0; octet2: SU bf b7,
#         MU bf b6, UL MU-MIMO b5, UL MU-MIMO+OFDMA b4, DL MU-MIMO+OFDMA b3, UL OFDMA b2, DL OFDMA b1, b0 reserved
#         (audit 2 SPEC). MCS: k/4 sets, each Rx map then Tx map, each 2 octets BIG-endian (A3). k in {4,8,12}; any other
#         k is InvalidLength (builder A choice, mirrors D3 line 222 for 0xAA: no whole Rx/Tx sets). HE160/HE8080 vs k: carried.
#   0x91: ResultCode(1), then FrameBody (802.11 (Re)Association Request frame body, raw bytes, D5) iff ResultCode = 0x00.
#         Any other code (0x01 failure, 0x02-0xff reserved, raw) has no FrameBody: octets after it are TrailingBytes.
#         Code 0x00 with an empty FrameBody is a spec case (upstream writes it when the stored body is empty).
#   0xb2: CC(2 raw octets), Num_Radio(1), per radio { RUID(6), Num_Types(1), per type { Method(1), Duration(3, BE;
#         audit 8 UPSTREAM), Num_OpClass(1), per op class { OpClass(1), Num_Chan(1), Num_Chan x Channel(1) } } }.
#         All counts may be 0. Methods 0x04-0xff reserved, raw.
#   0xb4: Max Prioritization Rules(1), reserved octet(1), octet: Byte Counter Units b7-6 (3 reserved, raw),
#         Prioritization b5, DPP Onboarding b4, Traffic Separation b3, b2-0 reserved; Max VIDs(1). Exactly 4 (audit 171).
#   0xbe: RUID(6), octet: Combined Front Back b7, Combined Profile-1/2 b6, MSCS b5, SCS b4, QoS Map b3, DSCP Policy b2,
#         QM_SCS_Traffic_Description b1, b0 reserved. Exactly 7 (audit 185: upstream's multi-record receive is not spec).
#   0xcb: RUID(6), octet: Included b7, b6-0 reserved; MAC(6) present iff Included = 1. Included=0 -> exactly 7 octets,
#         Included=1 -> exactly 13. Lenient (D4): empty value -> Ok(None), "absent" (em_capability.cpp:619-659, :861).
#   0xaa: RUID(6), Num_Role(1), per role { octet: Agent Role b7-6 (2-3 reserved, raw), HE160 b5, HE8080 b4,
#         MCS NSS Length b3-0 = octet count L; L octets MCS NSS = L/4 sets, each Rx map then Tx map, each 2 octets
#         LITTLE-endian (A3); octet: SU Beamformer b7, SU Beamformee b6, MU Beamformer Status b5, Beamformee STS <=80 b4,
#         Beamformee STS >80 b3, UL MU-MIMO b2, UL OFDMA b1, DL OFDMA b0; octet: Max DL MU-MIMO TX b7-4, Max UL MU-MIMO
#         RX b3-0; Max DL OFDMA TX(1); Max UL OFDMA RX(1); octet: RTS b7, MU RTS b6, Multi-BSSID b5, MU EDCA b4,
#         TWT Requester b3, TWT Responder b2, Spatial Reuse b1, ACU b0 }. Per role 1 + L + 5 octets. L in {4,8,12}, other
#         L InvalidLength (D3 line 222). HE160/HE8080 vs L: carried (consumer). Num_Role may be 0; 3 roles accepted.
#   0xd4: lsn(1), SerialNumber(lsn), lsv(1), SoftwareVersion(lsv), lee(1), ExecutionEnv(lee), Num_Radio(1),
#         Num_Radio x { RUID(6), lcv(1), ChipsetVendor(lcv) }. Strings are raw octets (not checked as UTF-8; a trailing
#         0x00 is kept). Each length <= 64: 65 or more is InvalidLength. Num_Radio ">=1": 0 is InvalidLength (D8).
#   0xdd: octet: KiBMiB Counter b7, Early_AP_Capability b6, b5-0 reserved (Table 116 prints "bits 6-0"; bit 6 is
#         Early_AP_Capability, so read as bits 5-0); then n >= 0 reserved octets (spec form, ignored on decode; the encoder
#         writes none). At least 1 octet; no TrailingBytes case exists for this TLV.
#   0xdf: MaxNumMLDs(1); octet: AP_Maximum_Links b7-4, bSTA_Maximum_Links b3-0 (15 reserved, raw); octet: TID-To-Link
#         b7-6 (2 reserved, raw), b5-0 reserved; 13 reserved octets; Num_Radio(1); per radio { RUID(6), 24 reserved octets,
#         octet: AP STR b7, NSTR b6, EMLSR b5, EMLMR b4, b3-0 reserved; octet: bSTA STR b7, NSTR b6, EMLSR b5, EMLMR b4,
#         b3-0 reserved; then 8 groups in order AP STR, AP NSTR, AP EMLSR, AP EMLMR, bSTA STR, bSTA NSTR, bSTA EMLSR,
#         bSTA EMLMR, each Num_Records(1) + Num_Records x { RUID(6), octet: Freq_Separation b7-3, b2-0 reserved } }.
#         Num_Radio and every Num_Records may be 0; Num_Records is not capped at 8 (audit 274).
#   (1) Fields are listed in wire order. A count or length item (opclasses, oN_nonop, radios, rN_types, rN_tM_opclasses,
#       rN_tM_oK_chans, roles, mcs_len, rN_mcs_len, rN_<group>_n) is the value written on the wire; only the entries
#       listed follow it (a count above the listed entries = overstated). For 0xd4, a string's length octet is its octet
#       count unless <name>_len is given, which is then the length octet written.
#   (2) Values: decimal or 0x-hex; every integer is 1 octet unless stated: 0x87 tx_mcs/rx_mcs and 0x88 sN_rx/sN_tx are
#       2 octets BE; 0xaa rN_sK_rx/rN_sK_tx are 2 octets LE; 0xb2 duration is 3 octets BE; 0x85 oN_txpow is a signed
#       decimal written as one 2's complement octet. MACs/RUIDs are 6 octets. hex: values are raw octets.
#   (3) Bit sub-fields are given as unshifted values (tx_ss=3 means the 3-bit code 011; the HT/VHT/HE stream fields are
#       the wire code = streams - 1). Booleans 0/1. A `reserved`-style mask (reserved, reserved1, rN_ap_reserved,
#       rN_bsta_reserved, rN_<group>K_reserved) is given in octet position, ORed into that octet; absent means 0.
#       Whole reserved octets (0xb4 reserved_octet, 0xdf hdr_reserved 13 octets, rN_reserved 24 octets) are always
#       listed and written as given. A case that sets reserved bits/octets: the decoder ignores them; the encoder writes
#       zero (canonical bytes = same fields with the reserved items zero; e.g. 0xdf reserved-bits-clear).
#   (4) A bit-field octet is on the wire iff its sub-fields are listed (all of them, or none). An item given as hex:
#       where it normally takes a MAC/integer is a cut field: exactly those raw bytes are written. An entry field left
#       out (missing flags, missing count, missing length) is absent from the bytes.
#   (5) mcs_raw / rN_mcs_raw=hex: give the MCS octets raw, in place of the sets (only in InvalidLength cases).
#   (6) `trailing` = raw bytes appended after the listed fields. 0x91 `frame` = the FrameBody bytes (present iff listed).
#       0xcb `bsta_mac` is on the wire iff listed. 0xdd `ext` = the reserved trailing octets (spec form).
#   (7) kind=lenient;decoded=absent: decode_value_lenient returns Ok(None); the strict decoder rejects the same bytes
#   (8) Set naming: sN_rx/sN_tx is set N (N=0: <=80 MHz, 1: 160 MHz, 2: 80+80 MHz), Rx before Tx as on the wire.
#       0xdf records: rN_<group>K_ruid / rN_<group>K_sep; support flags rN_<group>_sup; counts rN_<group>_n.
# Choices: (a) every cut field, partial entry or overstated count/length is error=Truncated (as B01-B03); extra octets
#   after a complete layout are TrailingBytes. (b) 0x88 k and 0xaa L not in {4,8,12} are InvalidLength, with exactly the
#   octets the bad length claims supplied. (c) 0xd4 Num_Radio=0 and any string length > 64 are InvalidLength.
#   (3 roles) and he160-flag-mismatch are kind=spec. (e) 0x87 upstream-le-bytes-read-as-spec pins that upstream's LE
#   bytes for tx 0xfffa / rx 0xfff5 decode as 0xfaff / 0xf5ff under the spec (audit 48). (f) Empty values of
#   0x86/0x87/0x88/0xaa are invalid/Truncated here (upstream writes them; reported as new lenient candidates, not added).
